Ecuador’s strength is obvious. They defend brilliantly. Sebastián Beccacece has built a side that stays compact, works relentlessly, and rarely gives opponents easy chances. Chelsea midfielder Moisés Caicedo is the heartbeat of everything. He breaks up attacks, carries the ball forward, and keeps the whole team ticking.
[...]
At the back, Paris Saint-Germain defender Willian Pacho and Arsenal centre-back Piero Hincapié form one of the strongest defensive pairings in the tournament. AC Milan full-back Pervis Estupiñán also gives Ecuador real energy down the left side.
[...]
The big question remains goals. Veteran captain Enner Valencia, is still Ecuador’s main penalty taker and biggest goal threat despite being 36. Gonzalo Plata of Flamengo and teenage talent Kendry Páez will need to provide support in attack.
[...]
Germany come into this match in strong form after scoring freely in recent games. Julian Nagelsmann’s side look dangerous going forward, especially with Jamal Musiala and Florian Wirtz linking up behind Kai Havertz.
[...]
Musiala, for Bayern Munich, remains Germany’s most unpredictable attacking player, while Liverpool midfielder Florian Wirtz gives them creativity between the lines. Joshua Kimmich is still expected to handle most set pieces and free-kicks, while Havertz should remain first-choice penalty taker.
[...]
The return of Manuel Neuer is another huge storyline. At 40, the Bayern Munich goalkeeper brings leadership and experience Germany probably missed in recent tournaments.
[...]

Galíndez; Preciado, Pacho, Hincapié, Estupiñán; Plata, Caicedo, Franco, Páez; Enner Valencia, Kevin Rodríguez

[...]
Germany clearly have the stronger squad on paper. Musiala, Wirtz, Havertz, Kimmich — there’s elite quality everywhere you look. But Ecuador won’t make life easy. Their midfield battle with Caicedo could shape the whole game.

You can imagine Ecuador staying compact for long periods and making Germany work for every opening. But eventually, Germany’s attacking depth may just prove too much over 90 minutes.

- Germany are four-time FIFA World Cup winners.
- Ecuador’s best World Cup finish came in 2006 when they reached the Round of 16.
- Ecuador conceded very few goals during CONMEBOL qualifying.
- Germany scored 19 goals across their last six matches listed.
- Moisés Caicedo remains Ecuador’s key midfield player.
- Jamal Musiala and Florian Wirtz are expected to lead Germany creatively.
